subject: Medisync contract renewal & environment scaling
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@medisync.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Contract renewal window + expected scale for Q3

Hi Connor,

We're getting our procurement timeline in order and I wanted to confirm a few things ahead of our renewal in late April. Our usage has grown faster than expected across three clinical analytics services; we're looking to: 

- Add dedicated isolation for the ECG and Imaging pipelines (separate VPCs)
- Provision two additional on-prem clusters at our East Coast site for low-latency inference
- Extend the contract term from 12 -> 24 months starting at renewal

Attached is a small export of last month's usage (usage_snapshot_20270228.csv) to give context. Can you outline what timeline and rough costs look like for the environment changes above? We'd also like a proposed one-page mutual action plan so procurement can track milestones.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops
Medisync

[attachment: usage_snapshot_20270228.csv]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medisync.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expected scale for Q3

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the snapshot. 

High level response: we can support the two additional on-prem clusters and the VPC isolation model you described. To get you actionable numbers and a timeline I'd like to confirm:

1) Expected steady-state TPS (inference requests/sec) per pipeline after Q3 scale
2) Average sequence length / model family in each pipeline (we need this for kernel selection and forecasted GPU hours)
3) Whether the East Coast clusters need air-gapped operation or just private VPC access over cross-connect

Next steps I propose: I'll work with Ben (account) and Priya (solutions) to draft a 1-page mutual action plan + an initial SOW and capacity proposal. Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow or Wednesday to lock down the capacity numbers? I'll include an option for an initial 12-month term with pricing tiers, and the 24-month extension price so procurement can compare.

I've looped in Ben for pricing/contract and Priya for the technical sizing.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medisync.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Contract renewal window + expected scale for Q3

Thanks for the details, Elena — quick technical notes from our side to prep the SOW and timeline: 

- Isolation model: we recommend two separate VPC environments (prod-ecg, prod-imaging) with explicit cross-account roles and subnet-level ACLs. This gives the separation you asked for while keeping the control plane unified for operations.
- On-prem clusters: for the East Coast site we're proposing N+1 clusters (3 nodes per cluster, commodity A100 equivalent) to meet low-latency SLAs. If you need true air-gap we'll need a slightly longer provisioning window and additional pricing line items for offline packaging.
- Data plane routing: we'll configure region-based smart routing so traffic from the East Coast switches to local on-prem clusters first, with fallback to Dedicated pools.
- Timeline: assuming we have final numbers by Wed 3/3, we can have VPC isolation configured in 3 weeks and the first on-prem cluster validated in 6 weeks. Full rollout for both sites (2 clusters) ~10 weeks.

Capacity inputs I need from you for firm pricing: expected concurrent sessions and peak tokens/min for each pipeline. If you don't have token-level numbers, the TPS + avg seq length will do.

I'm attaching an initial capacity workbook and a draft SOW section for the isolation work.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

[attachment: capacity_proposal_Q2-2027.xlsx]
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@medisync.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@medisync.io>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract renewal window + expected scale for Q3

Connor/Priya — thanks, this is helpful. Carlos and I reviewed the workbook and we're comfortable with the proposed topology. A few clarifications: 

- The East Coast clusters will be air-gapped for imaging pipelines (regulatory requirement).
- Peak for Imaging: ~18 TPS, avg seq length 360 tokens.
- Peak for ECG: ~45 TPS, avg seq length 128 tokens.
- We prefer the 24-month term if pricing is within ~12% of the 12-month price. Procurement needs an estimated total contract value for their approval packet by Friday 3/5.

Can Ben share a preliminary commercial summary (TCO over 12 vs 24 months with the isolation/on-prem lines)? If you can also include standard SLA language and a DocuSign-ready SOW, that would get us moving.

Best,
Elena

On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 08:15 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:

Hi Elena / Carlos — sorry for the slight delay, pulled numbers together and attached a clean SOW + the pricing workbook (Medisync_SOW_v2.pdf + capacity_proposal_Q2-2027.xlsx). High level: 

- 12-month option (baseline): $1,180,000 total (includes two on-prem clusters, VPC isolation setup, standard SLAs)
- 24-month option (preferred by Medisync): $2,120,000 total (effective discount ~10%, includes air-gap packaging for imaging site, priority onboarding and 99.9% platform SLA)
- One-time onboarding & air-gap packaging fee: $35,000
- Target timeline (post sign): VPC isolation in 3 weeks, first on-prem validation in 6 weeks, full rollout ~10 weeks.

Next steps I'd propose: 
1) If the 24-month option looks good, sign the SOW copy (DocuSign link below) and we'll start procurement kick-off immediately.
2) We'll issue a mutual action plan doc with named owners and milestone dates.
